title: External inspection required.
officialText:
All high and low pressure boilers shall have an annual external inspection
performed in accordance with section 204 of New York state labor law and the rules of the department. Such inspection
shall include chimney connectors.
**§28-303.2.3 Electric high pressure boilers. Electric boilers operating at pressures or temperatures classified as high
pressure boilers, as defined in the New York city mechanical code, shall be annually inspected as high pressure boilers
in accordance with this article.
**Section 28-303.2.3 was added by Local Law 126 of 2021. This provision has an effective date of January 1, 2022
